results.title: The digitization of agricultural industry – a systematic literature ...
results.content: ## Smart Agricultural Technology. # The digitization of agricultural industry – a systematic literature review on agriculture 4.0. The results show the extent of digital technologies adoption in agriculture. The potential benefits of digital technologies and roadblocks hindering their implementation in agriculture sector are identified and discussed. This study, therefore, aims to contribute to the development of agriculture 4.0 by investigating the emerging trends of digital technologies in the agricultural industry. After applying the protocol, 148 papers were selected and the extent of digital technologies adoption in agriculture was examined in the context of service type, technology readiness level, and farm type. Finally, potential roadblocks to the digitization of the agriculture sector were identified and classified at technical and socio-economic levels. This comprehensive review results in providing useful information on the current status of digital technologies in agriculture along with prospective future opportunities.
